_comment: GitHub repository metadata (description + topics) for the published NORA-HAL
snapshots. Edit this file, then run set_repo_meta.ps1 -WhatIf to see the diff and
without -WhatIf to apply. Re-running is idempotent.
Topics are a set, not a list: GitHub sorts them itself, lowercases them, and allows
only [a-z0-9-] (max 50 per repo, 50 chars each). The CK values below were derived
from the AK siblings measured on 2026-08-11 with ak->ck applied; where the AK repo
had no topics at all, the source of the set is named per repo.

repos.name: nora-hal-dspic33ck-spi-i2s-tdm
repos.description: SPI framed-mode I2S/TDM transport HAL for Microchip dsPIC33CK devices.
repos._topics_source: AK spi-i2s-tdm had none; taken from AK dma's set (ak->ck) plus 'spi', minus 'sport' which is not a dsPIC33CK peripheral name

repos.name: nora-hal-dspic33ck-dma
repos.description: Small, readable low-level DMA HAL for Microchip dsPIC33CK devices.
repos._topics_source: AK dma (ak->ck), 'sport' replaced by 'dma' -- SPORT is not a dsPIC33CK peripheral and the AK set was missing its own subject

repos.name: nora-hal-dspic33ck-timer
repos.description: Small, readable Timer HAL for Microchip dsPIC33CK devices (Timer1 tick + SCCP1 high-resolution counter).
repos._topics_source: AK timer had none; built from the AK clock/uart pattern (family + toolchain + subject) plus 'sccp', which is what this family uses instead of Timer2

repos.name: nora-hal-dspic33ck-gpio
repos.description: Small, readable GPIO and PPS HAL for Microchip dsPIC33CK devices.
repos._topics_source: AK gpio (ak->ck); 'pkob4' -> 'curiosity-nano' (this family's boards use nEDBG, not PKOB4), 'curiosity-board' dropped for the same reason, 'pps'/'embedded-c'/'mplabx' added

repos.name: nora-hal-dspic33ck-clock
repos.description: Small, readable PLL and system-clock HAL for Microchip dsPIC33CK devices.
repos._topics_source: AK clock (ak->ck); 'clkgen' dropped because this family has no CLKGEN block, 'oscillator' added in its place

repos.name: nora-hal-dspic33ck-i2c
repos.description: Small, readable blocking-master and interrupt-slave I2C HAL for Microchip dsPIC33CK devices.

repos.name: nora-hal-dspic33ck-uart
repos.description: Small, readable UART HAL for Microchip dsPIC33CK devices.

repos.name: nora-hal-dspic33ak-spi-i2s-tdm
repos.description: SPI framed-mode I2S/TDM transport HAL for Microchip dsPIC33AK devices.
repos._topics_source: backfill: this repo had an empty description and no topics. Mirrors the CK entry above, ak spelling, keeping 'sport' which is an AK peripheral name
